verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              तथा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु संसक्तेषु च सञ्जय । संशप्तकान् कथं पार्थो गतः कर्णश्च पाण्डवान् ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said While armies thus encountered each other, did Partha, O Sanjaya, assail the Samsaptakas and Karna the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विस्तरशो युद्धं प्रब्रूहि कुशलो ह्यसि । न हि तृप्यामि वीराणां शृण्वानो विक्रमान्रणे ॥२॥
verses.english: Skilled in narration as you are, recount at length the incidents of the battle to me. I am never satiated with listening to the accounts of the prowess of heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तदास्थितमवज्ञाय प्रत्यमित्रबलं महत् । अव्यूहतार्जुनो व्यूहं पुत्रस्य तव दुर्नये ॥३॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Disregarding the huge hostile array arranged in that way Arjuna rayed his force in proper form on account of the evil policy of your son.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सादिनागकलिलं पदातिरथसंकुलम् । धृष्टद्युम्नमुखं व्यूहमशोभत महद्बलम् ॥४॥
verses.english: The huge army of the Pandavas, abounding in infantry, cavalry, elephants and cars and led by Dhristadyumna, looked magnificent.

verses.sanskrit: पारावतसवर्णाश्वश्चन्द्रादित्यसमद्युतिः । पार्षतः प्रबभौ धन्वी कालो विग्रहवानिव ॥५॥
verses.english: With his horses white as the pigeons and endued with the effulgence of the sun or the moon the son of Prishata, with bow in hand, shone like Death himself in body.

verses.sanskrit: पार्षतं जुगुपुः सर्वे द्रौपदेया युयुत्सवः । दिव्यवर्मायुधधराः शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः ॥६॥
verses.english: The sons of Draupadi desirous of fighting stood by the side of the son of Prishata. They had celestial coats of mail and weapons and were powerful like tigers. They followed him like stars following the moon.

verses.sanskrit: सानुगा दीप्तवपुषश्चन्द्रं तारागणा इव । अथ व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु प्रेक्ष्य संशप्तकान्रणे ॥७॥
क्रुद्धोऽर्जुनोऽभिदुद्राव व्याक्षिपन् गाण्डिवं धनुः । अथ संशप्तकाः पार्थमभ्यधावन्वधैषिणः ॥८॥
verses.english: Beholding he Samsaptakas in battle array, Arjuna, worked up with anger, rushed against them, drawing his Gandiva bow.

verses.sanskrit: विजये धृतसंकल्पा मृत्युं कृत्वानिवर्तनम् । तन्नराश्वौघबहुलं मत्तनागरथाकुलम् ॥९॥
verses.english: With a view to kill Arjuna the Samsaptakas bent upon acquiring victory, advanced against him, making death their end.

verses.sanskrit: पत्तिमच्छूरवीरौघं द्रुतमर्जुनमार्दयत् । स संप्रहारस्तुमुलस्तेषामासीत्किरीटिना ॥१०॥
verses.english: Those brave warriors with men, horses, infuriate elephants and cars began quickly to assail Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव नः श्रुतो यादृङ्निवातकवचैः सह । रथानश्वान् ध्वजान्नागान्पत्तीन्रणगतानपि ॥११॥
verses.english: Furious was their encounter with Kiritin. It resembled that between Arjuna and Nivata Kavachas, as we have heard.

verses.sanskrit: इषून् धनूंषि खड्गांश्च चक्राणि च परश्वधान् । सायुधानुद्यतान्बाहून्विविधान्यायुधानि च ॥१२॥
verses.english: Thousands and thousands of cars, horses, flags, elephants, foot-soldiers engaged in fighting, arrows, bows, swords, discus, battle axes, uplifted arms holding weapons and heads of enemies were cut by Partha.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद द्विषतां पार्थः शिरांसि च सहस्रशः । तस्मिन्सैन्यमहावर्ते पातालतलसन्निभे ॥१३॥
निमग्नं तं रथं मत्वा नेदुः संशप्तकास्तथा । स पुनस्तानरीन्हत्वा पुनरुत्तरतोऽवधीत् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Considering his car drowned into that whirlpool of warriors resembling the bed of the was nether region the Samsaptakas sent up loud war-cries.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन च पश्चाच्च क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशूनिव । अथ पञ्चालचेदीनां सृञ्जयानां च मारिष ॥१५॥
verses.english: Slaying all his enemies in front Partha killed those that stood at a distance, then those that were on his right and back like Rudra himself killing in anger the entire animate creation.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयैः सह संग्राम आसीत् परमदारुणः । कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः ॥१६॥
verses.english: And exceedingly dreadful the encounter of your army with the Panchalas, Chedis and Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टसेनाः सुसंरब्धा रथानीकप्रहारिणः । कोसलैः काश्य-मत्स्यैश्च कारूषैः केकयैरपि ॥१७॥
verses.english: Kripa, Kritavarma, Shakuni, the son of Subala, with cheerful soldiers, all greatly worked up with anger and capable of striking the car-warriors fought with Kosalas, the Kachis, Matsyas, Karushas, Kekayas and Surasenas all of whom were highly terrible in battle.

verses.sanskrit: शूरसेनैः शूरवरैर्युयुधुर्युद्धदुर्मदाः । तेषामन्तकरं युद्धं देहपाप्मासुनाशनम् ॥१८॥
क्षत्र-विट्-शूद्रवीराणां धर्म्यं स्वर्ग्यं यशस्करम् । दुर्योधनोऽथ सहितो भ्रातृभिर्भरतर्षभ ॥१९॥
verses.english: That great battle, destructive of life, body and sins, brought on fame, virtue and heaven for all the Kshatriya, Vaishyas and Sudra heroes that engaged in it.

verses.sanskrit: गुप्तः कुरुप्रवीरैश्च मद्राणां च महारथैः । पाण्डवैः सह पाञ्चालैश्चेदिभिः सात्यकेन च ॥२०॥
verses.english: O best of Bharatas, meanwhile, the king Duryodhana, with all his brothers and Kuru heroes and many powerful Madraka carwarriors, protected Karna while he fought with the Pandavas, the Panchalas, the Chedis and Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: युध्यमानं रणे कर्णं कुरुवीरोऽभ्यपालयत् । कर्णोऽपि निशितैर्बाणैर्विनिहत्य महाचमूम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Destroying that huge army with his sharpened arrows and assailing many leading car-warriors Karna afflicted Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमृद्य च रथश्रेष्ठान् युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत् । विवस्त्रायुधदेहासून् कृत्वा शत्रून्सहस्रशः ॥२२॥
युक्त्वा स्वर्गयशोभ्यां च स्वेभ्यो मुदमुदावहत् । एवं मारिष संग्रामो नर-वाजि-गजक्षयः । कुरूणां सृञ्जयानां च देवासुरसमोऽभवत् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Sundering the armour, weapons and bodies of thousands of his enemies, killing them by thousands and sending them to heaven to earn fame Karna gave great delight to his friends.
